# Local Commitment. Regional relationships. A Strong voice for HALF MOON BAY.
Steven Booker is the only candidate in this race endorsed by the San Mateo County Democratic Party, every single member of the San Mateo County board of supervisors and a broad range of regional leaders.
Steven Booker is an Air Force veteran, electrician, labor leader, and longtime Half Moon Bay resident who has spent decades standing up for working families. Steven is focused on the issues Half Moon Bay residents confront every day: housing people can afford, good local jobs, safer roads, reliable infrastructure, and strong emergency preparedness
​
Steven is a proven coalition builder, a respected voice endorsed by local and regional leaders, and the only candidate in this race endorsed by the San Mateo County Democratic Party. He listens, brings people together, and will be a strong, unifying voice for the Coastside who will use his regional relationships to bring resources and results home to the Coastside.

## Endorsements
Steven Booker is proud to have the support of Half Moon Bay, County and State leaders as well as regional organizations. Steven is the only candidate in this race endorse by the San Mateo County Democratic Party and al five members of the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors
#### Half Moon Bay
Deborah Penrose, Half Moon Bay City Council District 5
Belinda Arriaga Hernandez, Founder and CEO of ALAS
#### San Mateo County
Jackie Speier – San Mateo County Supervisor, District 1
Ray Mueller – San Mateo County Supervisor, District 3
Lisa Gauthier – San Mateo County Supervisor, District 4
Noelia Corzo – San Mateo County Supervisor, District 2
David Canepa – San Mateo County Supervisor, District 5
Hector Camacho – San Mateo County Supervisor, District 2 (School Board)
#### State
San Mateo County Deputy Sheriff Association
Marc Berman – California State Assemblymember, District 23
Diane Papan – California State Assemblymember, District 21
Kevin Mullin – U.S. Representative, California's 15th Congressional District
#### Organizations
San Mateo County Democratic Party, Plumbers UA 467, and additional local labor associations
IBEW 617 (International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers)
San Mateo County Building and Construction Trades Council
San Mateo County Labor Council
#### Other Supporters and Endorsers
• Joaquin Jimenez, former Mayor, Half Moon Bay
• Harvey Rarback, former Mayor, Half Moon Bay
• Aisha Baro, Community Leader
• Stacy McCarthy, Community Leader
• RJ Jennings, Community Leader
• Nicole Fernandez, San Mateo City Council
• Adam Lorraine, San Mateo City Council
• Lisa Diaz-Nash, San Mateo City Council
• Robert Newson, San Mateo City Council
• Sue Beckmeyer, Pacifica City Council
• Greg Wright, Pacifica City Council
• Willa Chapman, Sea Horse Ranch
• Lisa Petrides, San Mateo County Community College District Board of Trustees
• Charles Stone, former Mayor of Belmont
​
​
Donate
Half Moon Bay, California
Contact: steven@bookerforhmb.com
## What his supporters are saying
LOCAL VOICES
“
### Steven Booker has been on the front lines serving San Mateo County in numerous leadership roles, especially on the front lines with union workers and those working hard for our communities. He knows firsthand what communities need to thrive and grow. Now he is bringing his leadership home to the Coastside where he lives—to be on the ground with all of us and to keep us united.
##### Belinda Arriaga
Founder and CEO of ALAS
Local Voices
“
### I have been on the council for 12 years and I know what it needs: a voice that is connected to the broader region. That is the only way we get better jobs, more funding for housing and infrastructure, and better visibility for our little town. Steven is that voice and has my full support.
##### Dr. Deborah Penrose
City Council Member, District 5
State
“
### Steven is committed, collaborative and a voice people listen to. Half Moon Bay would benefit from his representation.
##### Senator Josh Becker
California State Senator, District 13
